batches.description: Atomic writes, backups, corruption detection, because every tool depends on them
Zod schemas and the derived types that guard every state file
Snapshot layout, scope collection and the automatic trigger that guards risky operations
Manifest creation, verification and the transactional restore with its journal
Pinning, drills, pruning caps and the tool that exposes them to the user
Scaffolding, deltas and complexity routing, which is where artifacts come into being
Audit and clean, which are the two paths that write fixes to an inconsistent project
Health, self healing, performance telemetry and its plugin, which all read damaged state
The phase machinery that validates, reports, approves and advances the workflow
Configuration, the protected file guard and its plugin, which share the protected path list
